title: Own Professional Website with AI (No Coding) | Just 15 Minutes
topic: AI ki help se apni website banana chahte hain, lekin poora project zero se code nahi karna?
description: AI ki help se apni website banana chahte hain, lekin poora project zero se code nahi karna? Is video mein ek ready-made website project ko apne channel/brand ke hisaab se customize karne aur GitHub Pages par publish karne ka workflow dikhaya gaya hai. Is approach mein har webpage ko manually edit karne ke bajaye kuch data/configuration files update ki jaati hain, phir AI assistant ko project README aur files samjha kar changes karwaye ja sakte hain.
